body: The common thread is that being right is not the point. Pros focus on payoff asymmetry and sizing (Druckenmiller/Soros), on how their view differs from what is already priced in (Marks's second-level thinking, Steinhardt), and on feedback loops between price and fundamentals (Soros). Systematic edges like the magic formula work *because* they are painful to hold.

body: `insight:balance-sheet-survives-cycle` · confidence: unverified Leverage taken on in an upcycle was the common thread in every big Indian sector wipeout. Infrastructure and EPC in 2007–12 (Lanco, GVK, Punj Lloyd, Gammon) used debt plus aggressive bids. Thermal IPPs in 2010–13 had untied PPAs and imported coal. Steel in 2011–16 (Bhushan, Essar, Monnet) ended in IBC. Real estate in 2008–19 (Unitech, Jaypee) diverted customer advances. NBFCs in 2018–19 (IL&FS, DHFL) borrowed short to lend long. Private banks in 2018–20 (Yes Bank) grew loans ahead of deposits. Retail in 2019–20 (Future Group) expanded on debt. The survivors and compounders entered the downturn with net cash or low leverage and gained share when weak players exited: UltraTech and Shree in cement, JSW after its 2016 recovery, HDFC Bank and Kotak in 2008 and 2018, Bajaj Finance after 2008, Radico through FY17–21 deleveraging (D/E 0.77 to 0.15). Sector-specific balance-sheet tests: lenders on deposit/CASA franchise and ALM; cyclicals on net debt/EBITDA under 2x at mid-cycle margins; EPC on working capital and receivables over a year; developers on net debt against annual collections; utilities on discom receivables. Lesson: in cyclical and financial sectors, screen out stretched balance sheets first, then pick on growth. **lesson:** Survive first: screen leverage and funding structure before growth; downturn share gains build the next decade's winners. **examples:** Lanco/GVK 2012; Bhushan/Essar IBC; Unitech/Jaypee; IL&FS/DHFL 2018–19; Yes Bank 2020; Future Group 2020 Sources: [1](https://ticker.finology.in/discover/market-update/hdfc-bank-q2-fy27-results-analysis) · [2](https://www.newkerala.com/news/a/hfcs-emerge-stronger-after-fy26-stress-asset-quality-215.htm) Links: similar_to `insight:avoid-ruin`, illustrates `case_study:radico-khaitan`, about `insight:disqualifiers`
